items.title: Cars.com, Booking, EverQuote, Expedia, and CarGurus Stocks Trade Down, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after the rapid adoption of Meta’s new autonomous AI assistant, Muse, sparked concerns over structural disruption to digital marketplaces and digital advertising revenues. Meta’s Muse rose to the top free-app position in U.S. app stores, Business Insider reported, driven by growing consumer interest in personal AI agents capable of researching products, booking travel, and completing forms across external websites. items.title: Meta’s Muse Can Book Your Vacation—and Travel Stocks Are Paying the Price
items.summary: Expedia, Booking, and other travel stocks fell on worries that artificial personal assistants could siphon off some of their business.

items.title: Meta’s Muse Drags Down Stocks That Depend on ‘Consumer Inertia’
items.summary: Shares of major banks, insurers and online travel agencies slid on Tuesday as investors fear that tools like Meta Platforms Inc.’s personal AI agent could disrupt businesses that benefit from so-called consumer inertia, the tendency to keep buying something out of habit even when a better alternative exists.
